issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event uses "infra-(a)" ("§5/§6 powered-ablation deterministic harness (infra-(a)) is complete") without defining what infra-(a) denotes. A standalone reader cannot determine whether this is a sub-task label, a program phase identifier, or something else. Recommend expanding to e.g. "(the infra part (a) of the §5/§6 program: adjudicate B-2d4c + checks B-ebbb + run-driver B-f248 + analyze B-7036)" or simply dropping the parenthetical since the story list is already given.
